reasoning_runtime.effective_configuration_verification: No independent runtime configuration metadata inspected in this production step; requested settings are not a claim about server response tier.

intent: Targeted revision of Ironclad v0.1: lightly built adult body, relaxed garment fit, thin compact shoulder/forearm/shin plates; retain face, equipment colors, meaningful action and scene.
pipeline: Bundled scripts/image_gen.py invoked directly; inline code only loads dotenv, invokes CLI, records hashes and suppresses raw exceptions; no custom SDK generator.
input_fidelity: Not sent: gpt-image-2 image inputs use high fidelity.

prompt.cli_normalization: Leading/trailing whitespace stripped by bundled CLI.

input_images.role: Edit target: adult Ironclad identity, face, equipment, scene and action; body proportions, cloth fit and armor mass are changed.

silent_reference_scope: Visually consulted for clear illustrated light only; Silent image was not sent to the API and its face/body/palette were not copied.
authentication: dotenv_values(interpolate=False); only OPENAI_API_KEY from specified file passed to CLI child; no shell sourcing, key output, key storage or raw exception logging.
preflight: First dry-run comparison rejected the CLI stripped final newline before any live API call; comparison corrected to match bundled CLI normalization.
selection_stage: Production candidate selected for body extraction by art-ironclad-production; parent final selection and merge pending.
selection_basis: Short, close-fitting shoulder plates expose a narrower frame.
Forearm guards and shin plates are reduced; lower legs read through flexible trousers.
Adult facial identity, silver-gray hair, restrained gaze, hand flame, bronze/red/charcoal identity, sword and carried mask remain readable.
Weight still rests through planted feet and upright sword; no spectator-facing expression or additional exposure.

visual_inspection.method: view_image detail=original of v01, Silent v05 and v02
findings: One adult human-faced woman, fully uncovered face and short swept-back gray hair.
Armored shoulder silhouette narrows visibly; upper-arm bulk and greave coverage are reduced.
Torso is narrower with modest cloth folds; some fitted chest/waist shaping remains.
Longitudinal leg proportions change only modestly; no exact head-count or body measurement claimed.
Gaze and curled flame hand retain intent; two arms, grip, knees, feet and whole sword have no obvious discontinuity.
Bronze shoulder/forearm/knee plates, red-brown underclothes, charcoal torso, hip mask and angular sword guard retained.
Upper-arm plates and long greaves were simplified; a dark folded hip cloth panel appeared during the garment revision.
No Silent image supplied to API, no borrowed green outfit/hood/daggers or hunting pose.
unconfirmed: Parent final production selection and merge.
Successful breathing/flame control cannot be verified from still artwork.
Rig deformation, game display and combat event synchronization are not validated.
Cross-character final gallery comparison remains parent integration work.

runtime_contract_checked.scope_resolution: 2026-10-09 steering explicitly supersedes the earlier rig-edit exclusion and authorizes character rig.json with measured image markers. Renderer code remains outside this assignment.
runtime_contract_checked.body_layers: One full-body cutout retaining her own carried sword, mask and localized palm flame; no independent companion entities.

steering_latest.directive: Body plus rig.json; markers use image-left/image-right, display_height 300 provisional, weapon-holding hand documented.
